edges.reason: constructor mints the full supply to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
transfer/transferFrom pass _msgSender as the from address into _transfer.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender before transferring ownership.
onlyOwner gates enableTrading using the caller address.
onlyOwner gates the manual LP burn using the caller address.
onlyOwner gates marketing wallet replacement using the caller address.
onlyOwner gates dev wallet replacement using the caller address.
tx.origin is used as the mapping key for the per-block transfer delay, an origin-based control.
lastLpBurnTime is set from block.timestamp, making burn eligibility time dependent.
_transfer compares block.timestamp against lastLpBurnTime to trigger auto burn.
manual LP burn cooldown is enforced using block.timestamp.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens stamps lastLpBurnTime with block.timestamp.
_transfer calls swapBack when the contract balance passes the swap threshold.
_transfer calls autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens on eligible sells.
swapBack converts tokens to ETH via swapTokensForEth.
swapBack adds liquidity when liquidity tokens and ETH remain.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates the write to the internal setter.
enableTrading sets tradingActive to true.
enableTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
enableTrading initializes lastLpBurnTime.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping.
updateMarketingWallet overwrites marketingWallet.
updateDevWallet overwrites devWallet.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount overwrites swapTokensAtAmount.
updateMaxTxnAmount overwrites maxTransactionAmount.
_transfer toggles the swapping guard around swapBack to block reentrant swap paths.
_transfer accumulates the liquidity share of fees.
_transfer accumulates the marketing share of fees.
_transfer accumulates the dev share of fees.
_transfer updates the balance ledger of from/to/contract.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to classify buys and sells.
_transfer enforces maxTransactionAmount on buys and sells.
_transfer enforces maxWallet on buys and plain transfers.
_transfer compares contract balance against swapTokensAtAmount.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForLiquidity.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForMarketing.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForDev.
constructor initializes marketingWallet from owner().
constructor initializes devWallet from owner().
constructor sets _totalSupply through the mint.
constructor assigns the minted balance to msg.sender.
swapBack performs a low-level value call to the dev wallet before finishing.
swapBack performs a final low-level value call to the marketing wallet.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router fee-on-transfer swap.
addLiquidity invokes the router addLiquidityETH with ETH value.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() after transferring to dead.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() after transferring to dead.
auto burn moves pair tokens to 0xdead through super._transfer.
manual burn moves pair tokens to 0xdead through super._transfer.
_transfer computes fees with mul/div and subtracts them from amount.
swapBack distributes ETH using mul/div and subtractions on balances.
constructor performs the single _mint of the fixed supply.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
addLiquidity approves the router before adding liquidity.
_transfer pushes fees to the contract via super._transfer.
Malicious dev wallet can re-enter swapBack during the low-level value call.
Malicious marketing wallet can re-enter swapBack during the final value call.
The router swap re-enters the token via transfer, which triggers _transfer.
addLiquidityETH pulls tokens via transferFrom, re-entering _transfer.
pair.sync() calls back into the token balanceOf after the burn.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a transient call argument consumed only by the transfer logic.
to is a transient call argument consumed only by the transfer logic.
amount is a transient value mutated and forwarded inside _transfer.
fees is produced entirely by the fee arithmetic operation.
contractTokenBalance is a local cache gating the swapBack call.
tokenAmount is the sole input forwarded to the router swap.
path is built only to feed the router swap call.
tokenAmount is passed directly to addLiquidityETH.
ethAmount is the value forwarded on the addLiquidityETH call.
contractBalance is a capped local read used only inside swapBack.
totalTokensToSwap aggregates fee buckets solely for swapBack math.
liquidityTokens is the token amount handed to addLiquidity.
amountToSwapForETH is the amount passed into swapTokensForEth.
ethForDev is the exact value sent by the dev wallet low-level call.
ethForMarketing determines the marketing payout branch.
ethForLiquidity is the ETH value paired in addLiquidity.
percent is the owner-supplied input that scales the manual burn.
amountToBurn is the value moved to the dead address by super._transfer.
newMarketingWallet is written straight into marketingWallet.
newAmount is validated then stored as swapTokensAtAmount.
liquidityPairBalance is a local read used only for the automatic burn math.
amountToBurn is the value moved to the dead address by super._transfer.
newOwner is validated and stored as the new _owner.
